title: GCP-6.4: Python GCP CoAP server resources absent — only /handoff mounted; no /info, /slots, /channels, /nodes endpoints
description: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md GCP-6.4 resource table (L193-204, R-08-033), sweep 2026-09-09: /.well-known/lichen-gw/{info,slots,channels,handoff,nodes}. Evidence: Rust mounts all six (rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs dispatch :2326-2348). C mounts info/slots/channels (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_slot_coord.c:1785-1826) + handoff (coap_handoff.c:1065-1080); C /nodes missing (bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.18). PYTHON mounts ONLY the handoff resource (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/handoff.py:53 site.add_resource) — no /info, /slots, /channels, /nodes resources exist, and the slot-claim POST handler (which would apply lichen.gateway.slot_claim verify + 4.03/4.09/2.04 semantics) has no CoAP layer at all: the library returns (accepted, reason) tuples with no CoAP mapping. A python gateway therefore cannot serve GCP-6.4 GETs or authenticate slot claims at the resource boundary. Related: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.18 (C /nodes + 32-entry cap/Block2), project-LICHEN-worker6-pttk (C lichen-gw GETs plaintext), project-LICHEN-worker6-6ffc (slot-claim dispatch authz tests). Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/ (info.py, slots.py, channels.py, nodes.py) + mount in the gateway site config. Acceptance: python gateway answers the GCP-6.4 resource table with the same CBOR shapes as the vectors (gateway_coordination.json, gcp6_slot_coordination.json), POST /slots enforces COSE_Sign1 validation with 4.03/4.09/2.04 mapping, and GETs are OSCORE-protected per R-08-035.
